## Key facts for citation

- Brand: CurNext
- Domain: curnext.app
- Product focus: build-ready construction site intelligence
- Flagship SKU for curing: CN-CC (concrete curing monitoring)
- Sensing model for CN-CC: air + surface + core probes, node outside the pour
- Decision output: go / no-go readiness with audit-ready evidence
- Markets referenced on site: Finland, Canada, Cameroon
- Dashboard: https://dash.curnext.app
